kebab_example: aliyun ga list-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paging query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50，默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener instance
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values:
default: the default endpoint group.
virtual: the virtual endpoint group.
Empty value: all default and virtual endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组类型。取值：

default：默认终端节点组。
virtual：虚拟终端节点组。
空值：表示查询所有默认终端节点组和虚拟终端节点组
parameters.name: endpoint_group_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the access log feature. Valid values:
on: enables the access log feature.
off: disables the access log feature. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问日志。取值：
on：开启访问日志。
off（默认值）：关闭访问日志
parameters.name: access_log_switch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the endpoint group. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

It can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签键。
一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the endpoint group. The tag value can be an empty string.

It can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

EnableClientIPPreservation.description_en:
Specifies whether client IP address preservation is enabled by using the automatic retrieval method. Valid values:
true: Client IP address preservation is enabled.
false: Client IP address preservation is disabled

是否开启了自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

false: Client IP address preservation is not enabled by using the Proxy Protocol
EnableProxyProtocol.description_zh:

EndpointGroupIpList.description_en:
The list of outbound public IP addresses of the endpoint group.

<notice>
For endpoint groups that use private network back-to-origin routing, the console displays only the private back-to-origin addresses and no longer displays public addresses. If the network connectivity type of the backend service in an endpoint group changes, such as from a private network to a public network, or to a hybrid of public and private networks, monitor the changes in back-to-origin addresses and ensure synchronization when updating the access control list (ACL) of the backend service.</notice>
EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh:
终端节点组出公网IP列表。

<notice>
私网回源类型的终端节点组在控制台仅展示私网回源地址，不再展示公网地址。如果终端节点组后端服务的网络连接类型发生变更（例如由私网变更为公网，或调整为公私网混合回源），请及时关注回源地址的变化，并同步更新后端服务的ACL列表。</notice>

EndpointIpVersion.description_en:
The backend IP address protocol. Valid values:  
IPv4: GA uses only IPv4 addresses to communicate with the endpoint service. This is the default value.  
IPv6: GA uses only IPv6 addresses to communicate with the endpoint service.  
ProtocolAffinity: GA uses the same IP protocol to communicate with the endpoint service as the IP protocol used by client requests
EndpointIpVersion.description_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：  
IPv4：（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。  
IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。  
ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service provider to which the managed instance belongs.

This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:
true: The instance is a managed instance.
false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that users can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true.
When an instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: An action policy that users can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: create an instance
Update: update the current instance
Delete: delete the current instance
Associate: reference or be referenced by the current instance
UserUnmanaged: unmanage the instance
CreateChild: create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称。
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The child resource type. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource
IpSet: acceleration region resource
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource
Endpoint: endpoint resource
EndpointGroupDestination: endpoint group protocol mapping resource under a custom routing listener
EndpointPolicy: endpoint access policy resource under a custom routing listener
This parameter is valid only when the Action parameter is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型。
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. Users do not have the permissions to perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. Users can perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the endpoint group. Valid values:
init: initializing
active: normal
updating: updating
deleteing: deleting
State.description_zh:
终端节点组的状态。
init：初始化。

active：正常。

updating：更新中。

deleteing：删除中
